# 1. Patch
## Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", 
                   basic_config$Type, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Level, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Name, " / R = ", 
                   basic_config$Radius
                   )
    )


```

## Abiotic Pannel

```{r}

# Import
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(x,y))

# Abiotic variables
abiotic_vars <- colnames(abiotic) 

# Plot list
plot_list <- list()

# Plot loop
for(i in 1:length(abiotic_vars)){
  
  # Metric
  metric <- abiotic_vars[[i]]
  print(metric)
  
  # Config
  config <- list(
    Type = "abiotic",
    Metric = metric)
  
  # Grid
  grid <- grid_read(config)
  
  # Plot
  plot_list[[i]] <- plot_grid(grid) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(caption = grid$config$Name) +
    theme(
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,   # centré
        size = 9,
        face = "bold.italic"
      )
    )
  
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 10)

```

## Botanical Model (Count,NCI,I/O)

```{r}

# Configurations
bota_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  # Level = "Species",
  # Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("Presence", "Count"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20,
  Norm = TRUE)

nci_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  # Level = "Species",
  # Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("Hyp"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10000,
  Beta = 1.79,
  Norm = TRUE)

genet_conf <- list(  
  Type = "genet",
  # Level = "Family",
  # Name = "Fabaceae",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = "Reads",
  Rar = TRUE,
  Marker = c("Sper01"),
  Norm = TRUE,
  Filt = TRUE)

config_tab <- bind_rows(list(bota_conf, nci_conf, genet_conf))

# Generate grids
grid_list <- build_grids(config_tab)

titles <- list(
  "Presence / Absence",
  expression(bold(Count~"("~R==20~")")),
  expression(bold(Hyp~"("~beta==1.79~")")),
  "Sper01 Reads"
)

# Generate plots
plot_list <- Map(function(grid, title){
  plot_grid(grid, stems = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title)
}, grid_list, titles)

# Wrap
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)

```

# 2. Unused but useful

## 1. Rank / Abundance Curve

### Classical (3 plots)
```{r}

library("entropart")

# Plot list
par(mfrow = c(1,3))

bota <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
plot_Whittaker_bota(bota, "Family")

plot_list <- lapply(c("Sper01","ITS2"), function(m){
  metabarlist <- import_genet(
  list(
    "Marker" = m,
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))
  plot_Whittaker_genet(metabarlist, "family")
  title(main = m)
})


```

### Version DIY (Same plot, normalized)

```{r}


# Multi marker curves + bota

vec_list <- lapply(c("Sper01","ITS2"), function(m){
  metabarlist <- import_genet(
  list(
    "Marker" = m,
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))
  Ab_tib <- rank_ab_tib_genet(metabarlist, "family") %>%
    mutate(Marker = m)
})

bota <- import_bota(list("Year" = 2012))
vec_list[[3]] <- rank_ab_tib_bota(bota, "Family") %>%
    mutate(Marker = "Bota")

multi_marker_rank <- bind_rows(vec_list)

ggplot(multi_marker_rank, aes(x=Rank,y=Dominance,color = Marker)) +
  theme_light() +
  geom_point(shape=21) +
  scale_y_log10()


```

### External datasets coverage

```{r}

# Morpho
morpho <- import_plants_morpho() %>%
  pull(Species)

# Sper01
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "Sper01")

g_gh <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# ITS2
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "ITS2")

g_its <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# 18S
config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "18S")

g_18s <- import_genet(config)$motus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pull(species)

# Bota
bota <- import_bota(list(Year=2012)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Species)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pull(Species)

# Nouragues
nour <- import_plants_nouragues() %>%
  pull(species)

length(morpho)
length(g_gh)
length(g_its)
length(g_18s)
length(bota)
length(nour)

# Diagramme de Venn

library(UpSetR)

# créer une liste
listes <- list(
#  M = morpho,
  Sper01 = g_gh,
  ITS2 = g_its,
  S18 = g_18s,
  B = bota,
  N = nour
)

# convertir en format UpSet
data_upset <- fromList(listes)

# -- Plot --
UpSetR::upset(data_upset,
      nsets = ncol(data_upset),
      order.by = "freq",
      show.numbers = "yes",
      set_size.show = TRUE,
      set_size.scale_max = 3000) 

```

### Linear model BA / OTU

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------
load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# --------------------------------------------------
# SELECT
# --------------------------------------------------

# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  OTU    = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[7]],
  BA  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Clade")     # inner join

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------
ggplot(compare, aes(x = OTU, y = BA)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red") +
  labs(
    y = "Basal Area (m²)",
    x = "OTU Richness"
  )

```

### Families compare proportion 2D

```{r}

# List of dataframes
dfs <- list(
  genet    = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[2]],
  bota  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes
compare <- dfs %>%
  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Clade")     # inner join

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = genet, y = bota)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() +
  xlim(0, 60) + 
  ylim(0, 60)

```

### Test taxonomical grouping

```{r}

# Configurations
config_rad <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = TRUE,
  "g.Marker" = c("Sper01"),
  "g.Metric" = "H1",
  "b.Radius" = 10,
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "b.Metric" = "H1",
  "Metric_corr" = "OTU",
  "Level" = c("Species","Family"),
  "Name" = "All",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

plot_list <- lapply(1:2, function(i){
  row <- config_rad[i,]
  configs <- extract_configs(row)
  
  # Read Bota grid
  grid_bota <- grid_read(configs$bota)
  p1<-plot_grid(grid_bota)
  
  # Read Genet grid
  grid_genet <- grid_read(configs$genet)
  p2 <- plot_grid(grid_genet)
  
  list("bota"=p1,"genet"=p2)
})

(plot_list[[1]]$bota | plot_list[[2]]$bota)

```
